en.headline: sogeisetsu: 17 own commits, 26 automated, and 5 issue actions on one smoke test
en.summary: On 2026-10-19 `sogeisetsu` made **17 own commits** in three repositories, plus 26 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. Ten own commits went to `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`: a summary-rendering fix for `###` headings swallowing text, a revert of two temporary test changes, a new AI-failure auto-diagnosis path with a manual `/oc` re-check entry, a fix for the invalid `toLower` in `opencode.yml`'s `if`, a corrected `verify` window assertion behind `check.yml`'s midnight failures, and pagination no longer treating HTTP 422 as fatal. `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` got 4 commits preparing `0.1.0-rc.0` and implementing spec v5 (relaxed enable criteria, atomic writes, hardened descriptions). `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` added 3 commits: eval artifacts moved into `evals/`, a DeepSeek V4.1 flash 1017 demo, and a new `reading-notes` category. Issue activity covered opening or closing 5 issues, all on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` `#9`, opened, commented on three times and closed. Two replies came from `github-actions[bot]` on `#9` and one from `yulia-ivashko` on `openchamber/openchamber` `#4899`; no pull requests, reviews, releases or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：17 次本人提交、26 次自动提交，issue 操作 5 项
zh.summary: 2026-10-19，`sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库共完成 **17 次本人提交**，另有 26 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 10 次：修复 summary 渲染中 `###` 小标题吞掉正文的问题、回滚两处临时测试改动、新增 AI 全失败自动诊断与 `/oc` 手动补查入口、修正 `opencode.yml` 的 `if` 中无效的 `toLower`、修正导致 `check.yml` 半夜必红的 `verify` 窗口断言，并让事件分页不再把 HTTP 422 当致命错误。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 有 4 次提交，准备 `0.1.0-rc.0` 并落地规范 v5（放宽 enable 判据、原子写、description 硬化）。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 3 次提交：测评产物收进 `evals/`、DeepSeek V4.1 flash 1017 演示、新增 `reading-notes` 类别。issue 方面新开或关闭 5 个 issue，全部集中在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 `#9`，该 issue 被新开、评论三次后关闭。收到 2 条来自 `github-actions[bot]` 的回复（在 `#9`）和 1 条来自 `yulia-ivashko` 的回复（在 `openchamber/openchamber` `#4899`）；当天没有 PR、review、release 或 discussion 记录。
